name: e-TurboFx
summary: e-TurboFx is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that uses Turbo JRSX and Momentum indicators to generate trading signals. It opens positions when both indicators align in the same direction and manages trades with fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. The EA operates systematically with configurable lot sizing and indicator parameters.
summary_zh: e-TurboFx是一个基于动量的专家顾问，使用Turbo JRSX和动量指标生成交易信号。当两个指标方向一致时开仓，并使用固定止盈和止损管理交易。该EA以系统化方式运行，具有可配置的手数和指标参数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于两个动量类指标的双重确认：Turbo JRSX指标（一种平滑的相对强度指数变体）和动量指标。入场条件为当Turbo JRSX和Momentum指标同时发出买入信号时做多，同时发出卖出信号时做空。出场条件采用固定止盈和止损方式，同时支持反向信号平仓。仓位管理使用固定手数模式，未实现动态资金管理。整体策略逻辑简单直接，依赖指标共振减少假信号，但缺乏趋势过滤器可能在震荡市中频繁止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA relies on dual confirmation from two momentum-type indicators: Turbo JRSX (a smoothed relative strength index variant) and the Momentum indicator. Entry conditions trigger a buy when both Turbo JRSX and Momentum generate bullish signals simultaneously, and a sell when both generate bearish signals. Exit conditions use fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with additional exit on opposing signal reversal. Position sizing employs a fixed lot approach without dynamic money management. The overall strategy logic is straightforward, relying on indicator confluence to reduce false signals, but lacks a trend filter which may cause frequent stop-outs in ranging markets.

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

pros: 双指标共振确认减少假信号，提高入场质量
固定止损止盈提供明确的风险控制边界
策略逻辑简洁清晰，易于理解和参数优化
Turbo JRSX指标经过平滑处理，信号更稳定
支持追踪止损功能，可锁定浮盈
pros_en: Dual indicator confluence reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit provide clear risk control boundaries
Strategy logic is concise and clear, easy to understand and optimize parameters
Turbo JRSX indicator is smoothed, producing more stable signals
Supports trailing stop feature to lock in floating profits
cons: 缺乏趋势过滤器，震荡行情中容易频繁止损
固定手数未实现动态资金管理，无法根据账户规模自适应
未做新K线检查，可能在同一根K线重复开仓
缺乏点差过滤，短线操作时滑点成本可能过高
指标周期固定，未针对不同时间框架做自适应调整
cons_en: Lacks trend filter, prone to frequent stop-outs in ranging markets
Fixed lot sizing without dynamic money management cannot adapt to account size
No new bar check, may open duplicate positions on the same bar
No spread filter, slippage costs may be too high for short-term operations
Fixed indicator periods not adaptive to different timeframes
improvements: 添加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX）避免震荡市频繁交易
实现动态手数计算（如基于ATR或账户余额百分比）以改善资金管理
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., MA direction or ADX) to avoid frequent trades in ranging markets
Implement dynamic lot sizing (e.g., based on ATR or account balance percentage) for better money management

risk_points: 未做新K线检查可能导致同一K线多次开仓，增加风险敞口
固定手数不随账户变化，大账户风险暴露可能过大或过小
缺乏点差过滤在高波动时段可能造成不利成交
risk_points_en: No new bar check may cause multiple entries on the same bar, increasing risk exposure
Fixed lot size does not scale with account, leading to potentially oversized or undersized risk
Lack of spread filter can result in unfavorable fills during high-volatility periods
